title: Duper's Auto Walk
description: A simple mod that allows you to walk without holding the forward key.
body:
# Duper's Auto Walk

This is a simple mod that adds a keybind, allowing the player to move forward without pressing the **W** key!

**WARNING: make sure that when using this mod on a server, you are not breaking any rules! Auto Walking is some times considered unfair advantage**

## Compatibility

- The Fabric version supports **ModMenu**, allowing the user to customize the Auto Walking Icon's position and whether it should be shown or not.
